Capco

Capco is a leading global technology and management consultancy that excels in driving digital transformation within the financial services and insurance sectors. With an unwavering commitment to delivering practical solutions, we empower our clients to navigate the complexities of today's fast-paced market. Our integrated services span across major financial hubs worldwide, ensuring that we are always close to our clients and their needs.

At Capco, we possess not only the expertise but also the vision and passion necessary to lead transformative change. As we embark on an exciting growth journey, this is the perfect moment to join our team. We are expanding geographically, increasing our workforce, and poised to disrupt the consulting landscape across APAC with our entrepreneurial spirit and agile methodologies.

About the Role

We are thrilled to introduce an opportunity for a talented AI Engineer to join our Singapore team. This role is designed for a technology innovator who thrives on solving complex challenges and is passionate about building AI-driven solutions that transform the Financial Services industry. As an AI Engineer at Capco, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of insurance by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and compliant solutions. Your work will enable our clients to unlock new efficiencies, enhance customer experience, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. If you are excited about applying advanced AI techniques to real-world business problems and driving measurable impact, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build multi-agent workflows to optimize business processes within insurance.
  • Develop and maintain software pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment using Python-based frameworks.
  • Train, fine-tune, and optimize neural network models, including LLMs, for specific use cases such as risk assessment and customer query resolution.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready AI applications.
  • Ensure AI models adhere to banking regulations, data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and ethical AI practices.
  • Monitor deployed solutions in production, troubleshooting issues, and implement updates as needed.
  • Strong experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services and technical components that support data, workflow, automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI/CD processes.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 3–12 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on software development and deployment.
  • Build and integrate components for LLM, RAG, search, agent-based and automation solutions,
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, Java, React Next, Node.js

  • Proven expertise working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, BERT) and building agentic solutions using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or ADK.

  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and bias mitigation.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
  • Understanding DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps workflows.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or certifications in AI/ML.
  • Strong communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

ELIGIBILITY TO WORK IN SG

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.description_text:
ABOUT CAPCO

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global management and technology consultancy specialising in driving digital transformation across the financial services industry. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, Capco combines innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to fast-track initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, and insurance. Our ingenuity is brought to life through our Innovation Labs, award-winning Be Yourself at Work culture, and a diverse, talented team across more than 30 offices worldwide.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Every consequential moment in financial services — approving a policy, extending credit, flagging a transaction, recommending a portfolio — is a decision. The best financial institutions do not leave those decisions to chance, intuition, or inconsistent human judgement. They engineer them: combining predictive analytics, business rules, and optimisation into decision services that are fast, consistent, auditable, and continuously improving. That discipline is Enterprise Decision Management.

As an AI Specialist in Enterprise Decision Management, you will lead the design and delivery of intelligent decision automation solutions for Capco's financial services clients across Asia. You will help clients move beyond point-in-time analytics and disconnected AI engines toward closed-loop decision systems: where predictive models inform rules, rules govern actions, outcomes are measured, and both models and rules are continuously refined as a result.

This role demands genuine depth across the full AI and decision management spectrum — from classical techniques such as expert systems, case-based reasoning, and scorecards, through to modern machine learning, optimisation, and large language model integration. We are not looking for generalists who discovered AI in the last few years. We are looking for practitioners who have spent a career building, deploying, and improving intelligent decision systems in production financial services environments.

Think of this as a forward-deployed role: you will be embedded with clients, building working solutions alongside their teams, and leaving behind capabilities that outlast the engagement. You will also play a defining role in building Capco's Enterprise Decision Management practice across Asia.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Decision Strategy & Architecture

  • Lead the design of end-to-end Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) architectures — connecting data ingestion, predictive model scoring, business rule execution, decision optimisation, and outcome measurement into coherent, production-grade decision services.
  • Advise clients on decision strategy: identifying which decisions to automate, which to augment, and which to keep in human hands — and designing the governance frameworks to manage each appropriately.
  • Model and decompose complex financial services decision domains — underwriting, claims adjudication, credit and affordability assessment, client suitability, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance — into structured decision architectures using DMN and related standards.
  • Define the feedback loops and monitoring frameworks that allow decision systems to learn from outcomes — closing the loop between prediction, decision, action, and measurement.

Predictive Analytics & Optimisation

  • Design and oversee the development of predictive models — including scorecards, logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural network approaches — that feed directly into operational decision flows.
  • Apply prescriptive analytics and mathematical optimisation techniques (linear programming, constraint optimisation, genetic algorithms) to maximise decision outcomes at portfolio or population level, not just at the individual transaction level.
  • Advise on champion/challenger frameworks, model validation approaches, and the governance of model changes within live decision systems — ensuring clients meet MAS, HKMA, and internal model risk management requirements.
  • Apply classical AI techniques — expert systems, case-based reasoning, Bayesian inference — where they are the most appropriate and explainable tool for a given decision problem.

Rules Engineering & Decision Automation

  • Distinguish clearly between rule engine integration concerns (deployment architecture, service exposure, API design, DevOps pipelines for rules) and rule service design concerns (authoring, testing, governance, and versioning of business logic) — and bring demonstrated expertise in both.
  • Design the interfaces between predictive model outputs and rules engine inputs — ensuring that model scores, segments, and recommendations are consumed correctly within decision flows and that the combined output is auditable.

Modern AI Integration

  • Integrate decision management capabilities with LLM and generative AI architectures — including patterns such as rules-based guardrails over LLM outputs, LLM-driven document understanding feeding structured rule evaluation, and conversational interfaces over decision services.
  • Advise clients on where deterministic, rules-based approaches and probabilistic, model-based approaches are best combined — and design hybrid architectures that preserve the auditability and consistency that regulated financial services require.

Practice & Client Development

  • Drive business development activities including proposals, RFP responses, client workshops, and thought leadership on decision intelligence and AI in financial services.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute actively to building Capco's decision intelligence practice, intellectual property, and accelerators across Asia

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Deliver robust, production-ready decision management solutions that demonstrably improve client decision quality, speed, consistency, and measurability.
  • Ensure decision systems meet the governance, auditability, explainability, and model risk requirements of financial services regulators across Asia-Pacific, including MAS and HKMA guidelines on the use of AI in decision-making.
  • Maintain and grow senior client relationships, acting as a trusted long-term advisor on decision intelligence strategy and roadmap.
  • Uphold Capco's standards of quality, integrity, and professionalism across all client engagements.
  • Contribute measurably to Capco Asia's decision management practice through reusable assets, methodology development, and external thought leadership.

THE PREFERRED CANDIDATE WILL

  • Have spent a decade or more building, deploying, and evolving intelligent decision systems in financial services — with a track record that spans the full EDM lifecycle from predictive model development through to rules-driven operational execution and outcome measurement.
  • Understand the complete toolbox of AI techniques available for decision problems — classical and modern — and have the experience and intellectual honesty to choose the right tool rather than default to whichever approach is currently receiving the most attention.
  • Be as fluent discussing scorecard development, Gini coefficients, and population stability indices as they are discussing transformer architectures, prompt engineering, and RAG pipelines.
  • Have deep domain expertise in insurance and/or wealth management decision logic, with secondary familiarity in banking or capital markets.
  • Be comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, a client-facing advisor, and a practice builder — often simultaneously.
  • Thrive in Capco's flat, non-hierarchical culture and bring an entrepreneurial spirit to the challenge of building a high-value, differentiated capability in Asia.

MANDATORY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Business & Domain

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in decision management, AI engineering, or a closely related analytical discipline within financial services.
  • Proven track record of delivering Enterprise Decision Management solutions in production environments — combining predictive analytics, optimisation, and business rules within operational decision flows.
  • Strong domain knowledge in insurance and/or wealth management: underwriting decision logic, claims assessment, policy eligibility, suitability frameworks, KYC/AML rules, or client segmentation and next-best-action engines.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders — Chief Analytics Officers, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Data Officers — on decision automation strategy and the business case for intelligent decisioning investments.

Technical — Decision Management & Classical AI

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise BRMS platforms in production: IBM Operational Decision Manager (ODM), FICO Blaze Advisor, Red Hat Decision Manager (RHDM), or IBM Drools — with the ability to distinguish and lead on both rule engine integration and rule service design.
  • Proficiency in decision modelling standards: DMN (Decision Model and Notation), PMML (Predictive Model Markup Language), and their use in documenting, governing, and exchanging decision and model assets.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing expert systems, including forward and backward chaining inference, Rete algorithm optimisation, and rule conflict resolution strategies.
  • Working knowledge of case-based reasoning (CBR), Bayesian networks, constraint satisfaction, and genetic and evolutionary algorithms — with experience applying these techniques to real financial services problems.
  • Experience designing and building traditional credit or insurance scorecards, including feature engineering, binning, weight-of-evidence encoding, logistic regression, and scorecard scaling.
  • Proficiency in decision optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint-based optimisation, and the application of optimisation to portfolio-level decision problems such as collections strategy, offer optimisation, or risk-based pricing.

Technical — Predictive Modelling & Modern AI

  • Working knowledge of machine learning model development, validation, and deployment lifecycle — including gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), ensemble methods, and neural networks.
  • Experience designing champion/challenger frameworks, model monitoring pipelines, and population stability analysis for models operating within live decision systems.
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations, with practical experience designing hybrid decision architectures that combine deterministic rule engines with generative AI components.
  • Familiarity with AI explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME, counterfactual explanations) and their application in regulated financial services decision contexts.
  • Experience with model risk management frameworks and the documentation requirements of MAS FEAT principles, HKMA guidance on AI, or equivalent regulatory standards.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with real-time and event-driven decision architectures, including complex event processing (CEP), streaming decision services, and sub-second decisioning requirements.
  • Exposure to insurance platform ecosystems (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco) or wealth platform ecosystems (Avaloq, FNZ, iCapital) and their integration

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join an engineering team at an AI infrastructure company focused on reinforcement learning environments and evaluation. You will build systems that make quality control for training data scalable, helping improve the reliability of data used to train and evaluate AI agents. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Automate quality control for training data generated through the platform. - Build quality systems grounded in human judgment and understanding, rather than relying heavily on large language models. - Define and enforce standards for training data quality. - Design experiments and metrics to evaluate agent outputs. - Work with data vendors to investigate quality issues, diagnose agent failure modes, and improve data generation processes. - Turn quality findings into sampling strategies and rule-based or model-assisted validation pipelines. - Incorporate quality insights into infrastructure tools and vendor workflows to reduce anomalies and edge cases. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in research engineering or a related technical role, especially in quality control automation. - A technical degree and proficiency with Python, Docker, and Linux. - Experience independently building scalable data validation pipelines and end-to-end automated QA or QC systems. - Experience with benchmarks and evaluations for reinforcement learning data, including realistic task design, reliable rubrics, and useful training trajectories. - Ability to define and measure training data quality, and design QC systems that use human judgment without heavy reliance on large language models. - Experience designing evaluation metrics and experiments, and collaborating with data vendors to resolve quality problems. - Knowledge of statistics, strong communication skills, curiosity, and comfort working independently in an early-stage environment. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary range: $100,000 to $170,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.
